newsitem.title: FRANCE: Camdessus convinced EU will solve econ policy rift.
newsitem.headline: Camdessus convinced EU will solve econ policy rift.

text.p: International Monetary Fund chief Michel Camdessus said on Wednesday he was convinced the European Union could find a solution to its discussions over how to co-ordinate economic policies after the launch of a European single currency in 1999.
"I'm convinced this problem will be resolved," he told reporters after a meeting with French Prime Minister Lionel Jospin.
He said there needed to be good co-ordination of economic policies in Europe.
He had been asked what he thought about a call made by the French Socialist party in its election campaign for a European economic government.
Camdessus earlier held talks with French President Jacques Chirac where he discussed preparation for the Group of Seven rich nations summit in Denver this month.
Camdessus noted that article 103 of the Maastricht Treaty provided for co-ordination among European countries on economic policies.
